create_UnrealStereo4KWAI_dataset: create an UnrealStereo4KWAI dataset instance with a specified split, root directory, and resolution
run_UnrealStereo4KWAI_viz: run the UnrealStereo4K dataset CLI to visualize scenes with rerun using the --viz flag
load_data_UnrealStereo4KWAI: load precomputed scene metadata and covisibility maps for the UnrealStereo4K dataset split
sample_views_UnrealStereo4KWAI: sample N views from a scene using pairwise covisibility and return image, depth, and camera data
get_parser_UnrealStereo4KWAI: get an argparse parser with root dir, metadata dir, num views, and viz arguments for UnrealStereo4K
